easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls a permanent that shares a type with the one you plan to give away.
description:
Pay {4}{U} to cast Burglar's Plot, exchanging control of a permanent an opponent controls and Old Fat Spider.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Old Fat Spider.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
